cases.translation: Men began to multiply on the earth.
cases.explain: The preposition на indicating location takes the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Не вечно будет дух мой в противоборстве с ___.
cases.translation: My Spirit will not contend with man forever.
cases.explain: The preposition с in the sense of 'together with / against' governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Ты войдешь в ___, ты и твои сыновья.
cases.translation: You will enter the ark, you and your sons.
cases.explain: The preposition в expressing motion into takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: У ___ было трое сыновей — Сим, Хам и Иофет.
cases.translation: Noah had three sons: Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
cases.explain: The preposition у (in the 'to have' construction) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: У Ноя было трое ___ — Сим, Хам и Иофет.
cases.translation: Noah had three sons: Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
cases.explain: The numeral трое (collective 'three') governs the genitive plural.

cases.sentence: Ной был праведен и безупречен, он ходил с ___.
cases.translation: Noah was righteous and blameless; he walked with God.
cases.explain: The preposition с in the sense of 'together with' governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Тогда Бог сказал ___, «Я положу конец всякому живому существу».
cases.translation: Then God said to Noah, 'I will put an end to every living thing.'
cases.explain: The verb сказать (to say to someone) takes its addressee in the dative case.

cases.translation: Make yourself an ark of cypress wood.
cases.explain: The preposition из (made out of) governs the genitive case.

reading.ru: Но Ной нашел милость в глазах Господа.
reading.question: How did Noah stand out to the Lord?
options: He found favor in the Lord's eyes
He was the oldest of all
reading.correct: He found favor in the Lord's eyes
reading.explain: The text says 'Ной нашел милость в глазах Господа' (Noah found favor in the Lord's eyes).

reading.ru: Среди людей того времени лишь только Ной был праведен и безупречен.
reading.question: How is Noah described among the people of his time?
reading.explain: The text says Noah alone 'был праведен и безупречен' (was righteous and blameless).

reading.ru: У Ноя было трое сыновей — Сим, Хам и Иофет.
reading.question: How many sons did Noah have?
reading.explain: The text says 'У Ноя было трое сыновей' (Noah had three sons).

reading.ru: Сделай себе ковчег из кипарисового дерева, и сделай в нем комнаты, и осмоли его изнутри и снаружи.
reading.question: What was Noah instructed to build the ark from?
reading.explain: The text says to make the ark 'из кипарисового дерева' (of cypress wood).

reading.ru: Ковчег должен быть с 300 локтей в длину, 50 локтей в ширину и 30 локтей в высоту.
reading.question: What was the length of the ark?
reading.explain: The text says the ark should be '300 локтей в длину' (300 cubits in length).

reading.ru: Но с тобой я заключу завет, и ты войдешь в ковчег, ты и твои сыновья, и твоя жена, и жены твоих сыновей.
reading.question: Who would enter the ark with Noah?
options: His sons, his wife, and his sons' wives
reading.correct: His sons, his wife, and his sons' wives
reading.explain: The text says Noah would enter 'ты и твои сыновья, и твоя жена, и жены твоих сыновей' (you, your sons, your wife, and your sons' wives).
